statistical_scope.cluster: four passages per corpus, paired starts/arms/boundaries share indices
statistical_scope.calibration: one fixed F, no fit/population calibration uncertainty
statistical_scope.multiplicity: unadjusted correlated contrasts, not independent replications
statistical_scope.primary: later-view early-only PC effect, orth effect, paired difference; every corpus/start
statistical_scope.effects: Support contrasts have unequal write counts/dose; no timing-versus-dose isolation, mediation, circuit uniqueness or equivalence claim.

scope.primary: Later-view early-only PC effect, orth effect and paired difference in every source/start stratum.
scope.primary_targets: 2..511; queries1..510. Primary mechanistic contrast view later targets128..511.
scope.secondary_views: Early targets2..127 and full targets2..511 share fixed512 execution.
scope.matching_acceptance_domains: All nonsourceq1..511 and scoredq1..510, main and full rotated suffix, three supports.
scope.norm_semantics: Targets/lambda/budgets and actual change norms are support-restricted; proposed full-write/pre-context norms remain hypothetical outside support.
scope.timing_evidence: All-query timing controls are recorded runtime fingerprints/flags; bounded sampled timing states and10 full snapshot states require separate independent audit. No unsaved whole-state reconstruction claimed.
scope.limits: Support sets differ in query count/natural dose. No timing-versus-dose isolation, mediation fraction, unique circuit, equivalence/absence, fidelity or generation claim.
